title: %compactObject - drop empty entries
purpose: Return a copy of an object with null, empty-string, empty-array, and empty-object values removed.
input:
notObj = "x"

{rec}
name = "Ada"
middle = ~
nickname = ""
zero = ##0
flag = ?false
notes: Drops ~ (null), empty strings, empty arrays, and empty objects; other falsy values such as ##0 and ?false are kept.
